made: node docs/proyecto/pixel/frente-sheet-make.js, from frente-set.html (window.FRENTE) and coqui/ref/escenas/frente/. Order 07.

rules.project: pp-engine.js project(x, y, z) with S 26 and this origin; a box is the screen bounding box of its 8 projected corners [floor(min x), floor(min y), ceil(max x) - floor(min x), ceil(max y) - floor(min y)]
rules.frog: a spot is the ground under his feet: q.x = round(sx) - 16, q.y = round(sy) - 25; q.s = the spot's scale
rules.abuela: a spot is the ground under her feet: her sprite is drawn at (round(sx) - 30, round(sy) - 49)
rules.bird: a point is under its feet: drawAve draws its bottom at y + 2
rules.frame: a point named with a frame is the old point plus the frame's offset (a whole number of pixels); points drawn relative to it (a rect, a sprite) move by the same offset
rules.sky: the sky is screen space: what lives in it (clouds, rain, the sun, the bird circling, the stars of marcador) keeps its old screen numbers
rules.view: a view has a zoom. zoom 1: the 196 x 216 window with x0 = clamp(round(sx - 98), 0, 44), sx the projection of its world point. zoom 2: the 98 x 108 region [clamp(round(sx - 49), 0, 142), clamp(round(sy - 54), 0, 108)] shown nearest-neighbour at two screen pixels per picture pixel (region is given). Never a fraction
rules.viewChange: between two views of the same zoom the window slides (camGo, whole pixels); between a zoom 1 and a zoom 2 view it cuts: no in-between sizes
rules.pair: a review or level picture is pictures[word.side] (level: level[...].picture): zoom 1 = the 196 x 104 window [clamp(round(sx - 98), 0, 44), clamp(round(sy - 52), 0, 112)]; zoom 2 = the 98 x 52 region [clamp(round(sx - 49), 0, 142), clamp(round(sy - 26), 0, 164)] shown nearest-neighbour at 2 x 2 in the 196 x 104 picture. crop is given. remap's cam and crop entries say what each old rectangle meant; for the pictures themselves pictures wins

lights.fromW: W.lamp (the lights inside; the old file calls it lamp, there is no porch lamp)

sky.fromW: W.dusk 2: sunset; W.dusk 1: dusk; else W.dark >= .33 or W.rain: rain; W.dark >= .27: storm2; W.storm or W.dark > 0: storm; else day

hide.fromW: W.escondite ? 1 : 0 (story 3: the small palm and the birdhouse stand in the garden)

side.fromW: only when rustle is not none: (F >> 1) % 2 ? 1 : -1 (escondite()'s sh(), frente.js:94); the rustling prop sits one pixel left or right

setKey.key: door + win + lights + sky + hide + rustle (+ side), e.g. "shut-shut-0-day-0-none"
setKey.bakedWhy: every state the stories, pairs and level pictures reach (coqui/ref/escenas/frente and a replay of the five stories), plus the rustle palma states a story can reach; each is a reference in coqui/ref/pp/frente/
setKey.notRead: W.abierto (escondite() reads it into a constant it never uses), W.mesa and W.caliente (the cake inside the window: sprite layer), W.nube, W.nube2, W.nube3, W.rain (moving: sprite layer; W.rain only picks the sky)
setKey.old: the old background sprite key was "fr" + door + "_" + win + "_" + lamp; the old W.storm / W.dark / W.dusk overlays (frente.js:163-165) are now the sky parameter
